mechanism: Rifampin is a potent CYP3A4 and CYP2D6 inducer that increases metabolism of nortriptyline, significantly reducing its plasma concentration and therapeutic efficacy.
action: Monitor nortriptyline plasma levels and clinical response closely; consider increasing nortriptyline dose or switching to alternative antibiotic if clinically feasible, as rifampin may reduce nortriptyline effectiveness by 40-50%.
